meta.description: Durham movers for apartments, houses and moves between Durham and Raleigh, plus interstate moves on our own trucks. Hourly local billing. Free quote.

overview: Plenty of Durham moves start with a choice between Durham and Raleigh, and some people make that move twice. Whichever way you go, our Triangle crews do the carrying and the bill runs by the hour.
Coming from another state? We carry that too.
sellingPoints: Long distance moves on our own trucks

servicesBlock.intro: Residential and apartment moves are the core of our Durham work, and packing or a long distance leg can be added. Pick what you need from the list.

whyChoose.h2: Why Durham Customers Book Better Life Moving

cards.title: One Crew for the Whole Triangle
cards.text: Durham, Raleigh, Cary and Chapel Hill are all covered by the same Triangle team, so a cross-Triangle move is one local job.

cards.title: Hours, Not Surprises
cards.text: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. A manager explains the total before booking.

cards.title: Packing Done for You
cards.text: Add full or partial packing and the crew boxes and labels the home before loading.

cards.title: Owned Trucks for Long Hauls
cards.text: Moving to or from another state, your things ride in our truck, driven by our crew.

faqHeading: What People Ask Before a Durham Move

faq.q: Do Durham movers from Better Life Moving go to Raleigh?
faq.a: Yes. A Durham to Raleigh move is a local move for our Triangle crews, billed by the hour.

faq.q: Is there a minimum charge for a Durham move?
faq.a: Yes, a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time, so smaller apartment moves stay reasonable.

faq.q: Can you pack my Durham apartment?
faq.a: Yes. Choose full packing or just the kitchen and fragile pieces, priced on the same quote as the move.

faq.q: Are Durham long distance moves quoted differently?
faq.a: Yes. Long distance moves are quoted at a flat rate, based on the date, home size and both addresses.

faq.q: Should I compare Durham and Raleigh before I move?
faq.a: It helps. Our blog has a Durham vs Raleigh guide, and either way the move itself is handled by the same crews.

faqClosing: More questions? Our FAQ page explains booking, billing and what the crew does on the day.

closing.h2: Move In or Out of Durham With Us
closing.body: Send the date and both addresses, and a manager will walk you through the price.
